_comment: hostcron schedule - the single source of truth for host-side recurring jobs.
Migrated off Windows Task Scheduler on 2026-09-23. Commands, working
directories and times are carried over verbatim from the task definitions;
weekly day-of-week was recovered from each task's LastRunTime (all Sunday).
schedule fields: minute / hour / dow / dom. null = any, int = exact,
list = any-of. dow is 0=Sunday .. 6=Saturday. Times are host-local (ET),
Every job MUST carry timeout_s - nothing on this box runs unbounded.
Edits here apply within a minute; the service re-reads this file each tick.
ZeroInfra-DockerGuiReclaim stays a Task Scheduler logon task. It hands the
Docker Desktop GUI from session 0 back to the interactive desktop, which a
session-0 service cannot do by definition. It fires once per logon, not on
an interval, so it is not part of the flashing-window problem.
The five claude.exe-driven jobs (ADA Master daily/weekly/monthly, A-finance
Daily Review, ADA Financial Repos weekly) are disabled, not migrated. See
docs/native-review-replacement.md for the plan that replaces them.

jobs.name: ada-restart-window
jobs._note: Batches queued restart intents. Most ticks are a no-op; it only drains at the windows configured in restart_intent_store. Timeout covers the 20-min defer poll plus drain grace.

jobs.name: ada-frontend-prod-release
jobs._note: Builds committed master into the production frontend (ada-nginx :5421) and releases it only if a browser smoke passes; no-op when already current. 22:20 and 02:20 ET by owner choice 2026-09-28, after the :00 restart window settles and clear of the 03:00-04:00 backup.

jobs.name: ada-bitcoin-prod-release
jobs._note: Legion sprint 15301: releases committed master into ada-bitcoin-prod (the live-money Bitcoin engine) only when the bitcoin release paths moved; build, preflight (imports, alembic, schema, testctl ada:bitcoin), waits up to 45 min for zero live exposure outside :55-:10 and :28-:40, swaps, verifies, auto-rolls back. Skips quietly before the cutover. 06:15, 13:15, 21:15 ET, clear of the :00 restart window, the 22:20 frontend release and the 03:00 backup.

jobs.name: ada-post-land-verify
jobs._note: Sprint 15213: verifies a CLEAN checkout of master (imports, alembic single head + offline render of new migrations, tsc -b, ada:fast on changed paths) and posts ops-alerts on red. Only does work when HEAD moved since the last verified sha (.claude/state/post_land_verify.json). Chosen over a Legion test_schedule because it needs a worktree + a throwaway docker run on the host; the Legion `fast` schedule stays the working-tree test run (INF-08: one scheduler per job).

jobs.name: ada-stale-uncommitted
jobs._note: Sprint 15213: alerts when tracked-modified or untracked files sit uncommitted in the shared ADA tree for more than 24h (one Discord message per distinct set per day).

jobs.name: ada-master-pulse
jobs._note: 36 LLM-free probes; writes probe_cache/heartbeat/escalation.flag. Already native and 0-token - only its scheduler changes.
jobs._env_note: This job ran as the interactive user under Task Scheduler and so picked up the user site-packages. The service runs as LocalSystem, which does not, and probes.py died with 'FATAL: requests not importable' on every tick. requests is only installed in the user site dir (C:\Python314 system site-packages is not writable without admin), so PYTHONPATH points there explicitly. If the service is ever reconfigured to run as hadam, this can be dropped.

jobs.name: system-hub-daily
jobs._note: Fix-1100000738: daily System Hub review ring. Headless claude.exe (opus planner delegating to Sonnet, effort high, 150 turns, 20 USD cap, stream-json log, Fix-1100000753) measures the Hub Score, reuses or creates today's Legion sprint 'System Hub daily <date>', fixes red items, records the score row for the /system-hub Daily review card. Prompt: C:/code/ADA/scripts/setup/system_hub_daily_prompt.md. Exit condition: 7 consecutive days at score 0 -> verify only.

jobs.name: ada-master-watchdog
jobs._note: Rewritten for hostcron: reads hostcron heartbeat + runs.jsonl instead of Get-ScheduledTask LastTaskResult.

jobs.name: ada-bifrost-model-sync
jobs._note: 07:10, not 07:30: the sync recreates shared-bifrost, and at 07:30 that landed mid-way through customer-ops' personal-morning-brief (07:30 weekdays), whose local Qwen turn died on the restart (2026-10-01). Still before freellmapi-operator-disabled at 07:45.

jobs.name: ada-security-sweep-weekly
jobs._note: Trivy across 6 images with --pull-upstream plus a full-history secrets scan; the long timeout is intentional.

jobs.name: ada-dr-restore-drill-weekly
jobs._note: Restores the newest ADA AND Legion dumps into throwaway containers and row-diffs them against live; exit code is non-zero if either fails. ADA budget scales with dump size (min 1h); 3h outer bound.

jobs.name: ada-llm-weekly-report
jobs._note: Bifrost-native. rc 3 (all narrative lanes down) used to fall back to claude.exe; it now pages Discord instead. ok_exit_codes stays [0] so rc 3 surfaces as a failure.

jobs.name: ada-prompt-weekly-review
jobs._note: Bifrost-native. Same rc-3 treatment as llm-weekly-report.

jobs.name: freellmapi-operator-disabled
jobs._comment: Enforces bifrost/operator-disabled.json inside freellmapi (own key vault + fallback chain). Daily after ada-bifrost-model-sync.

jobs.name: shared-infra-gate
jobs._comment: Nightly quality gate (compose config, loopback ports, tests, ruff ratchet, stubs, PROVIDERS.md). Result: .claude/state/test-results/latest.json.

jobs.name: lane-eval-weekly
jobs._comment: Weekly lane quality eval (scripts/lane_eval_suite.json) over every active Bifrost lane. Writes state/lane_eval/, renders docs/LANE_QUALITY.md; exporter publishes bifrost_lane_eval_pass_ratio.

jobs.name: config-autocommit
jobs._comment: Commits live gateway routing state (config.json, disabled-providers.json) so git reflects what infractl and autoheal wrote.

jobs.name: testctl-serve-ensure
jobs._note: Supervises the test platform runner (testctl serve, :8790). No-op when it already answers; otherwise starts it detached. Legion's scheduler POSTs runs to it.

jobs.name: ada-docs-refresh-commit
jobs._note: Commits .claude/memory/topics/*.md files whose diff vs HEAD is confined below the docs_refresh auto marker (docs_refresh.py runs in ada-scheduler and never commits). Runs after the 03:00 UTC refresh (Enhancement-1001108).

jobs.name: ada-feature-map-nightly
jobs._note: Rebuilds the derived per-feature architecture maps (docs/architecture/**) and generated nested CLAUDE.md files. Commits only the changed generated files through ADA's safe_commit.sh (feature-map-commit.sh; skips when nothing changed) (Enhancement-1001108).

jobs.name: ada-daily-plan-commit
jobs._note: Lands docs/plans/daily/YYYY-MM-DD.md (written by ADA's daily_plan_render at 06:20 ET in ada-scheduler, which never commits) and regenerates STRUCTURE.md from the host, committing it when its table changed or the committed stamp is 3+ days old; the pre-push daily-plan-freshness gate blocks at 7 days (Fix-1100000839, sprint 15415).

jobs.name: ada-refresh-ava-test
jobs._note: Rebuilds the hermetic ava_test DB from adam's schema when its alembic head is stale, so pytest never logs relation/column-does-not-exist errors into the shared Postgres log.

jobs.name: backup-offvolume-daily
jobs._note: Copies the newest ADA + Legion dumps out of the Docker VHDX to C:\ProgramData\ops-backups (sha256-verified, 2 ADA + 3 Legion generations) after the 07:30 UTC (03:30 ET) dump has landed. Same physical disk; a true offsite target needs an owner-provided drive or cloud credential (BACKUP_OFFSITE_DIR).

jobs.name: ops-selfcheck
jobs._note: Nightly independent check that backups, the off-VHDX copy, the DR drill, hostcron jobs, port exposure, disk, containers and VRAM are healthy. Posts its own detail to the infra Discord webhook, so hostcron notification is off to avoid a duplicate.

jobs.name: ops-hostmem
jobs._note: Every 15 min: host RAM probe (available < 4 GiB posts to the infra Discord and pushes ops_host_mem_* to the Pushgateway; Prometheus rule HostMemoryLow). hostcron notification off: the script posts its own detail.

jobs.name: ops-reconcile
jobs._note: Every 10 min: brings an absent/exited must_run container back with compose up -d --no-deps <service> (scripts/ops_expected_containers.json). Pause switch: scripts/ops_reconcile.pause.
